other_failure_modes.description: Tree-based frameworks like LightGBM and XGBoost require multi-class targets to be strictly zero-indexed (e.g., 0, 1, 2). Passing unencoded targets that start from 1 (as in the CMC dataset's 1, 2, 3 classes) causes a fatal objective/metrics mismatch execution error.

other_failure_modes.description: The model's feature matrix concatenates the original columns with their label-encoded counterparts. If any original columns are of string type, passing them to LightGBM without explicit casting to 'category' will cause a crash, and for numeric columns, it creates redundant duplicate features.
